title: How Roger Leer began removing alien implants

tellings.quote: Well, he was a podiatrist and uh he was always interested in UFOs. He was um the most knowledgeable euphologist I've ever met. And um he um was at a UFO conference once and um uh Daryl Sims tried to get him interested in alien implants.

plain: Roger Leir, a podiatrist in Thousand Oaks, California, got into removing "alien implants", objects some believe aliens place inside people's bodies, after a man named Daryl Sims tried to interest him in them at a UFO conference. Steve Colbern, a scientist who worked with Leir, tells Michels this as what he knows of Leir's story, calling him the most knowledgeable UFO researcher he ever met.
